items.stem: Why is it inaccurate to say the Spanish conquered the Americas 'simply because of superior weapons'?

options.text: Epidemic disease, Indigenous allies and internal divisions were decisive alongside weaponry
options.rationale: Correct: demographic collapse and local alliances were central, not weapons alone.

options.text: Because the Spanish had no weapons
options.rationale: They had weapons; the point is they were not the sole factor.
Conquest occurred; the issue is explaining it fully.

options.text: Because Indigenous states did not exist
options.rationale: Large states existed and shaped events.

items.stem: Which TWO were major consequences of the Columbian Exchange for the Americas? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Catastrophic population decline among Indigenous peoples from new diseases
options.rationale: Correct: introduced epidemics caused massive mortality.

options.text: The introduction of new crops and animals that reshaped economies
options.rationale: Correct: exchanged species transformed agriculture and diets.

options.text: The immediate industrialisation of the Andes
The disappearance of all long-distance trade
options.rationale: Trade continued and was reorganised, not ended.

items.explanation: Correct: introduced epidemics caused massive mortality.

options.text: New states faced instability, caudillo rule and contested power long after independence
options.rationale: Correct: independence was followed by prolonged political struggle, not instant stable democracy.
Many did; the issue is what followed.

options.text: Independence happened only in the 20th century
options.rationale: Most came in the early 19th century.
Constitutions were written, but stability was elusive.
